therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Sequential high-dose IL-2 followed by checkpoint inhibition to enhance T-cell activation and anti-tumor immunity
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and proliferation via IL-2 signaling combined with checkpoint blockade to overcome immune suppression
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Metastatic melanoma patients (cutaneous and ocular subtypes)

safety_signals: No stopping rule events in either cohort

dose_info.dose: Aldesleukin 600,000 U/kg/dose; Nivolumab 240 mg IV (Cohort 1) or 3 mg/kg IV (Cohort 2); Ipilimumab 1 mg/kg IV (Cohort 2)
dose_info.schedule: Aldesleukin every 8-12 hours x5 days (days 1-5, 15-19); Nivolumab per protocol cycles; Ipilimumab per protocol cycles
